name: Lizard Man
comment: Melee only: XX_Slash 18241 (ability 1). The lizard_man look (the minifigure's) has ability_1 and chain motions only, and every spear throw asks for ability 2 or none at all (2026-10-30: its old skill asked for an ability animation its look lacks, so it stood stiff; tools/content/anim_audit.py). Look lizard_man_npc (522158; the minifigure's had no attack animations) with the T-Rex's hit and rawr (the user, 2026-10-30: the lizard guy has a basic melee attack and the minifigure's rawr). The bone and the stomp stay the boss's.
